projects.title: CloudOps: Azure GitOps Platform
projects.description: A production-grade GitOps monorepo deploying a Go/Nginx microservices architecture on a Terraform-provisioned Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster, featuring decoupled CI/CD and zero-credential security.

projects.title: Dynamic VMSS Auto-Discovery & Mesh
projects.description: An elastic Service Mesh architecture integrating Envoy Proxy with Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS), featuring metric-driven autoscaling and zero-downtime dynamic routing.

projects.title: LaporCepat: AI-Powered Disaster Reporting
projects.description: A real-time emergency reporting system that replaces manual call centers with an AI pipeline (Groq Whisper STT + Gemini 2.5 Flash) for instant triage and live dispatch.

projects.title: MySQL Load Test
projects.description: A high-performance load testing suite that captures real production traffic via PCAP analysis and replays it with weighted concurrency to accurately simulate database load.

projects.title: Azure End-to-End DevOps Pipeline
projects.description: A production-ready CI/CD pipeline and immutable infrastructure setup on Azure, featuring automated security scanning, zero-secret authentication, and dynamic telemetry injection.

projects.title: Dokku Nginx Path
projects.description: A Dokku plugin enabling path-based routing for multiple applications under a single domain, featuring automated Nginx configuration merging and unified SSL management.
